overview: 具身智能研究一个有身体、能行动的系统怎样理解环境并完成任务。机器人拿杯子时，识别出杯子只是开始：它还要决定从哪抓、移动多远、接触后怎样调整。感知、规划、控制和学习在这里接到一起，最终要落实到身体与环境的真实互动。
这页先从机器人操作认识问题，再向导航、移动和更复杂的身体扩展。示范学习让模型模仿人做过的动作；VLA 把视觉、语言与动作接起来；强化学习通过交互反馈改进策略。它们可以组合，数据覆盖、动作接口和评估条件往往和模型同样关键。
solves: 根据相机和身体状态执行抓取、放置等操作任务。
把人的指令转成适合具体机器人执行的动作。
在物体位置、背景或任务变化时继续行动，并用反馈修正偏差。
zh.stance: 看机器人演示时，先问它看见了什么、执行什么动作、在哪些初始条件下测过，再讨论泛化。

roadmap.title: 用多任务示范训练动作模型
roadmap.text: RT-1 把语言指令、相机观察与机器人动作连接起来，研究真实机器人数据的规模与多样性。

roadmap.title: 把动作序列作为生成对象
roadmap.text: Diffusion Policy 用去噪过程生成连续动作序列，让多种合理动作的分布有更合适的表达。

roadmap.title: 把视觉语言知识带进控制
roadmap.text: RT-2 把动作编码成 token，与视觉语言任务一起训练，探索语义知识怎样帮助机器人选动作。它与动作生成方法可以交叉。

roadmap.title: 用视觉语言模型生成连续动作
roadmap.text: π0 将预训练视觉语言模型与 flow matching 动作专家结合，用跨机器人数据学习通用策略，再针对任务微调。

roadmap.title: 把任务带到新的家庭环境
roadmap.text: π0.5 联合训练多种数据与任务，研究机器人在未见过的家庭环境中完成多阶段操作。

terms.text: 从示范中的观察与动作配对学习策略。示范没覆盖到的处境，往往也是部署时容易出问题的地方。
接收视觉与语言条件、输出动作的模型类别；动作可以是离散 token，也可以用连续数值表示。
一次预测接下来若干步动作，再执行其中一部分并重新观察。长度会影响平滑性与反馈频率。
执行后再次观察，根据环境的新状态调整动作；不同系统的反馈速度与接口并不一样。

checklist: 选一段抓取视频，写出指令、相机输入、动作表示和成功判据。
打开一个机器人数据样本，找到对应时刻的图像、身体状态与动作，说明它们是否同步。
比较同一个任务在新物体、新背景和新位置下的结果，把失败按感知、动作或接触阶段归类。

figure.title: 机器人任务的一次闭环

zh.paperIntro: 先看项目的任务视频，再读方法图；把相同任务的输入、动作输出和训练数据列在一起。

overview: Embodied AI studies how systems with bodies understand and act in their environments. Recognizing a cup is only the beginning: a robot must choose a grasp, move its body, and adjust after contact. Perception, planning, control, and learning meet in physical interaction.

Start here with manipulation, then branch into navigation, locomotion, and other bodies. Imitation learns from demonstrated actions; VLA models connect vision, language, and action; reinforcement learning improves behavior through feedback. These approaches can be combined. Data coverage, action interfaces, and evaluation conditions often matter as much as the model.
solves: Execute manipulation tasks from camera observations and body state.
Turn human instructions into actions a particular robot can execute.
Continue acting under changed objects or scenes, using feedback to correct errors.
en.stance: For any robot demo, identify observations, action outputs, and evaluated starting conditions before discussing generalization.

roadmap.title: Learn actions from multitask demonstrations
roadmap.text: RT-1 connects language, camera observations, and robot actions while studying the scale and diversity of real robot data.

roadmap.title: Generate action sequences
roadmap.text: Diffusion Policy denoises continuous action sequences, offering a way to represent several valid action choices.

roadmap.title: Bring vision-language knowledge into control
roadmap.text: RT-2 encodes actions as tokens and co-trains with vision-language tasks. Semantic transfer and action-generation methods are intersecting directions.

roadmap.title: Generate continuous actions with a VLM
roadmap.text: π0 combines a pretrained VLM with a flow-matching action expert, learning from cross-robot data before task-specific fine-tuning.

roadmap.title: Take tasks into new homes
roadmap.text: π0.5 co-trains on heterogeneous data and tasks to study multi-stage manipulation in previously unseen homes.

terms.text: Learning a policy from paired observations and demonstrated actions. Gaps in demonstration coverage often become deployment failures.
Models conditioned on vision and language that output actions, represented as discrete tokens or continuous values.
Several future actions predicted together. A system can execute part of the sequence, observe again, and replan.
Observe after acting and adjust to the updated environment. Feedback rates and control interfaces differ across systems.

checklist: For one grasping video, write down the instruction, camera inputs, action representation, and success criterion.
Inspect a robot dataset sample. Locate images, body state, and actions, and explain their timing alignment.
Compare the same task under new objects, backgrounds, and positions; classify failures by perception, motion, or contact.
en.paperIntro: Watch the task videos before reading the method diagrams. Compare inputs, action outputs, and training data across the projects.

papers.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale

zh.question: 一个模型能否从多任务机器人数据学习按指令行动？
zh.idea: 把图像特征与语言条件送入 Transformer，预测离散化后的机器人动作。
zh.why: 它让数据规模、任务多样性与机器人泛化之间的关系变得具体。
zh.read: 先看输入输出和数据采集，再看新任务、干扰与新环境的评估设置。
zh.limit: 结果依赖特定机器人与动作接口。

en.question: Can one model learn instruction-following from multitask robot data?
en.idea: Condition a Transformer on images and language to predict discretized actions.
en.why: It makes data scale and diversity concrete in robotics.
en.read: Inspect inputs, outputs, data collection, and generalization evaluations.
en.limit: Its results depend on a particular robot body and action interface.

papers.title: Diffusion Policy: Visuomotor Policy Learning via Action Diffusion

zh.question: 同一场景有多种可行动作时，怎样学出连贯的动作序列？
zh.idea: 以观察为条件，逐步去噪生成动作序列，执行一部分后再观察与预测。
zh.why: 它是理解生成模型怎样进入机器人控制的直观案例。
zh.read: 先看动作去噪与滚动执行，再看 Push-T 的成功和失败视频。
zh.limit: 多步去噪带来推理开销；示范覆盖与控制频率仍会限制部署。

en.question: How can a policy represent several valid, coherent action sequences?
en.idea: Denoise an observation-conditioned action sequence, execute part, then observe and predict again.
en.why: A tangible bridge from generative models to control.
en.read: Follow denoising and receding-horizon execution, then Push-T videos.
en.limit: Iterative denoising costs time; demonstration coverage and control frequency constrain deployment.

papers.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control

zh.question: 互联网上学到的视觉语言知识能否帮助机器人理解新指令？
zh.idea: 把机器人动作写成 token，与视觉语言数据联合微调，让模型直接输出动作。
zh.why: 它帮助理解 VLA 的出发点：语义知识怎样接到已有动作能力。
zh.read: 先看动作编码，再看语义泛化的任务与失败边界。
zh.limit: 语义泛化不自动带来新的底层运动技能，机器人示范仍然重要。

en.question: Can web-trained knowledge help robots interpret new instructions?
en.idea: Encode actions as tokens and co-fine-tune with vision-language data.
en.why: It connects semantic knowledge to existing action capabilities.
en.read: Read action encoding, then semantic-generalization tasks.
en.limit: Semantic transfer does not automatically create new low-level motor skills; robot demonstrations remain important.

papers.title: π0: A Vision-Language-Action Flow Model for General Robot Control

zh.question: 怎样把视觉语言模型接到连续动作，让同一个策略学习多种机器人的任务？
zh.idea: 在预训练视觉语言模型上接入动作专家，用 flow matching 生成连续动作序列；先用多种机器人的示范预训练，再用任务数据微调。
zh.why: 它把视觉语言预训练、动作生成和跨机器人数据放进同一套方案，接上了前面的 RT-2 与 Diffusion Policy。
zh.read: 从第一页总览图看数据和任务，再读动作专家的结构；对照预训练后直接执行与任务微调后的实验。

en.question: How can a vision-language model produce continuous actions across robot tasks and platforms?
en.idea: An action expert uses flow matching to generate continuous action sequences alongside a pretrained VLM. The policy is pretrained on demonstrations from multiple robots, then fine-tuned on task data.
en.why: It brings VLM pretraining, action generation, and cross-robot data together, connecting RT-2 and Diffusion Policy.
en.read: Start with the first-page overview, then the action-expert architecture. Compare direct use after pretraining with task-specific fine-tuning.

papers.title: π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization

zh.question: 机器人到了训练时没去过的家里，还能完成整理房间这样的长任务吗？
zh.idea: 在 π0 基础上联合训练机器人动作、子任务预测、物体检测和网络视觉语言数据，把高层子任务与连续动作连接起来。
zh.why: 它把问题推进到新家庭环境中的多阶段操作，适合看训练数据的组成怎样影响泛化。
zh.read: 先看第一页的数据来源与部署场景，再看新家庭环境的测试设置，以及不同数据来源的消融实验。

en.question: Can a robot carry out long tasks in homes it did not visit during training?
en.idea: Building on π0, the model co-trains on robot actions, subtask prediction, object detection, and web vision-language data, connecting high-level subtasks to continuous actions.
en.why: It studies multi-stage manipulation in new homes and how the mix of training data affects generalization.
en.read: Start with the first-page data and deployment overview, then inspect the new-home evaluation and data-source ablations.
